messages:
Maya: Quick cross-team check: observability roadmap milestone 3 (dash + traces + error-analysis) — are we aligned on OWNERS and blockers? cc @Raj @Sophie

Raj: We're blocked on trace-hook schema PR (#412) — awaiting eng-runtime review. @Jordan can you take a look?

Jordan: I'll review today. infra plan is a canary (25%) next Wed. Need confirmation of retention config: `trace.max_retention=30d`?

Sophie: Dashboards UI is ready, backend endpoints pending. ETA for per-route latency and error-rate views: Fri. I'm owning dashboard visuals.

Kelly: SRE notes: 90d full-resolution retention is expensive. Propose tiered retention (30d full, 180d aggregated). Any objections?

Maya: Quick owners recap: Console UI (Maya), Traces/trace hooks (Raj), Dashboards (Sophie), Retention policy (Kelly). Speak now or object.

Raj: SGTM. I'll wait for eng-runtime to merge schema. @CI-Bot any blockers on #412?

CI-Bot: Build status: ✅ green, but merge blocked due to conflict in `runtime/compat`.

Jordan: Taking the conflict now, will push a fix in ~1-2hrs. Ping me if CI flakes.

Sophie: Also: I'll add sample queries and alert rules for error analysis in a PR (link to follow).

Maya: Dependency chain to track: trace-hook PR -> runtime/compat merge -> infra canary -> dashboards wiring -> retention config rollout. Please add these to the roadmap card.

Kelly: Just added the dependency checklist to the board and set a tentative milestone for canary on 2026-04-01.

Raj: I'll add a reviewer checklist to the PR to speed validation.

Maya: Cool — let's reconvene async in 48h. If anything urgent, ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
